text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 55 vials of nafcillin sodium 2 g/8 mL with 3.5 days on hand. Corvale General holds 402 vials with 25.8 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 46 vials with 15.7 days on hand. The 1 g/4 mL presentations at all sites have adequate supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include nafcillin sodium as of 2026-10-21. The current 2 g/8 mL supply at Corvale East and Corvale General is labeled by Eugia US LLC under NDC 55150012316, with registered manufacturing plants including Apitoria Pharma Private Limited (VAI 2025-12-12), Aurobindo Pharma Limited (OAI 2025-09-05), and Eugia SEZ Private Limited (VAI 2019-03-01).

Our position: Internal transfer is the fastest way to protect Corvale East without new procurement risk. Alternate manufacturers either lack a named plant for regulatory review or are not on the FDA shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 168 vials of 2 g/8 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
2. Transfer 4 vials of 2 g/8 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
3. Monitor FDA shortage list and Eugia plant inspection status weekly — needs buyer.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., Avenacy Inc., or Baxter Healthcare Corporation at this time because their labels name no plant we could place for regulatory review and the drug is not on FDA's shortage list.
